title: bmp: fix peer down RFC9069 TLV parsing
description:
currently the dissector fails to parse VRF/Table Name TLV following Peer Down Notification reason code 6 as it assumes that it must be followed by a BGP PDU instead of a TLV

now, after the reason code is parsed, the dissectors does:
- v3: 
  - reason code 1/3: parse one BGP PDU
  - reason code 2: parse 16 bits FSM event code
  - reason code 6: parse a (**single**) VRF/Table Name TLV
  - other reasons code: no-op
- v4: parse like v3 does, but if an unknown TLV is encountered we switch over to v4 dissector early. then parse the rest with the bmp v4 tlv dissector.

i tried to reuse currently existing hf/ett types so i renamed all names used in both peer up and down from `*peer_up*` to `*peer_state*`.
i define a new typevals for peer down tlvs since we don't want to accept tlv that are valid for peer up but not peer down.
